name: Neighborhood Sampling
problem_statement: Sample multihop neighborhoods around seed vertices using declared fanouts and neighbor-selection probabilities.

normalization: Preserve all declared vertices, including isolated vertices.
Preserve direction; an undirected projection must be explicitly requested.
Declare the treatment of self-loops and parallel edges before execution; an adapter must reject unsupported cases.

problem_inputs.name: fanouts
problem_inputs.description: Per-hop nonnegative sample sizes; -1 explicitly means all neighbors.

problem_inputs.name: time_cutoff
problem_inputs.description: Optional timestamp upper bound; backend must explicitly support this variant.

required_outputs.name: sampled_edges
required_outputs.description: Original edge identities tagged with hop and seed/batch provenance.

solution_semantics.objective: Generate neighborhood samples with the declared distribution and fanout semantics.
solution_semantics.exactness: Structural validity and sampling semantics are exact; realizations are stochastic.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: Every sampled edge exists and satisfies type/time constraints.
Counts respect fanouts and replacement policy.
Distribution tests validate uniform or weighted selection.
edge_cases: Zero-degree seeds contribute no sampled edges.
Without replacement, fanout above degree returns all eligible neighbors.

correctness: Every sampled edge exists and satisfies type/time constraints.
Counts respect fanouts and replacement policy.
Distribution tests validate uniform or weighted selection.
